cast_to_fp4: cast a PyTorch tensor to FP4 format using straight-through estimator rounding and clamping to [-6, 6]
calculate_gparam: calculate the global scaling factor for NVFP quantization given a tensor and group size of 16
nv_fp4: quantize a PyTorch tensor to NV FP4 format with configurable group size, global scale, and max scale
nv_fp4_with_static_gs: quantize a PyTorch tensor to NV FP4 format using a static global scale derived from a provided tensor max value
fp4_v2_with_global_scale: quantize a PyTorch tensor to FP4 v2 format using unsigned E5M3 scale encoding with a provided tensor max value
